issue: PMAT-222 (forjar#499) — the build-I/O probe map was keyed by resource id alone, so a task declared on a local and a remote machine planned the remote row from the controller's probe: local inputs stale, remote row Update from a hash of the wrong tree; local inputs fresh, remote row NoOp with its tree unmeasured. The map is now keyed by (machine, resource id); a digest answers for the tree it was taken on and no other.

quorum.kill_rule: the plan was grilled before a line was written and the finished diff was judged by three lanes with the base pinned; a lane could fail the whole diff on one refuted claim, and every lane claim was re-run by the orchestrator before it counted — one claim all three lanes confirmed (the surface ceiling) was refuted by the workspace gate and fixed before this receipt was written
quorum.rounds: one sandboxed teamwork lane on the plan (7 child conversations measured; verdict implement-with-changes, three plan claims refuted and corrected before phase 1), then three sandboxed --mode plan lanes on the diff (3/3 PASS, every code claim confirmed, no dissent), then the orchestrator's reruns and the workspace gate
refuted_claims: A (String, String) tuple key is the right shape for the re-keyed probe map. Corrected: (String, String) has no Borrow<(&str, &str)>, so every lookup in the planner's loop would allocate; the map is one map per machine and get(&str, &str) allocates nothing.

The plan named every site the new type reaches. Corrected: ten planner test call sites, the api.rs re-export, the tests_api ceiling and core/task/mod.rs were missing; all are in the fix commit and the lib target compiles.

The lock's input_hash/output_hash are already right per machine because the lock is per machine (the issue's own premise). Corrected: record_io_hashes hashes the controller's tree into every machine's lock and check_task_input_cache reads it back for a remote cache: true task; filed as forjar#501, not widened.

The supported surface is 12 (confirmed by all three diff lanes by reading the literal). Corrected: the workspace gate read 8 — rustfmt had wrapped the five-item re-export and the ceiling test counts items per pub-use line; two single-line re-exports restore 12, measured by api::tests 7 passed and the workspace suite green.

crux.verdict: accept(Bazel: an action key carries the execution platform, so a digest is a fact about the tree it was computed from and never served to another; Nix: derivations are keyed by system and a cache answers only for the system it built; Ansible: facts live in hostvars keyed by the host they were gathered on) and reject(Make: one process, one tree, no notion of a remote target — the shape forjar had by accident)

agy_teamwork.mode: one sandboxed /teamwork-preview lane on the plan (7 children) and three sandboxed --mode plan lanes on the diff, review-only, base pinned by SHA; no lane ran cargo
agy_teamwork.verdict: plan: implement-with-changes on eight findings, three of them refutations that were corrected; diff: 3/3 PASS, every claim confirmed, no dissent — and one of those confirmations (C7) was then refuted by the workspace gate
